summary: BidBlitz Pay Gateway sandbox/mock integration testing completed. All core features working: payment creation, idempotency, mock wallet approval, cancel, refund, webhook, and audit logs. Fixed frontend route conflict for /pay/docs and api.js request body handling issue.

minor.issue: Route conflict with invoicing /{token} catch-all - returns 404 instead of directory listing

context_for_next_testing_agent: BidBlitz Pay sandbox integration is fully functional. All MOCKED wallet/app approval flows work as expected. Key fixes applied: (1) api.js request function was double-spreading options causing body to be stringified twice, (2) renderSpecialRoutes.jsx had route conflict where /pay/docs was caught by /pay/{token} pattern. Service worker updated to exclude /api/bidblitz-pay from caching.

features_tested.sandbox_page: PASS - /bidblitz-pay/sandbox loads correctly with form and status area
features_tested.payment_creation: PASS - Creates sandbox payment with redirect URL and pending status
features_tested.hosted_checkout: PASS - /bidblitz-pay/checkout/{paymentId} shows amount, status, and action buttons
features_tested.wallet_approval: PASS - Authenticated user can approve mock payment, status changes to paid
features_tested.cancel_flow: PASS - Cancelling pending payment changes status to cancelled, redirects to cancel page
features_tested.refund_flow: PASS - Refund creation works for paid payments, updates status to refunded/partially_refunded
features_tested.idempotency: PASS - Same idempotency key returns same payment
features_tested.webhook: PASS - Accepts valid signed payload, rejects invalid signature
features_tested.audit_logs: PASS - Admin can access audit logs with filtering
features_tested.legacy_routes: PASS - /pay/docs renders, /pay/checkout/{sessionId} handles invalid session gracefully

mocked_apis_confirmed: BidBlitz Pay wallet/app approval is MOCKED in sandbox mode
Refunds in mock mode return immediate success
